sense.observation: $13.99 in stock; replaces earlier $13.90 observation. Record actual supplied camera sensor.

xiao.observation: $7.49 in stock; bare XIAO ESP32-S3, no camera.

motors.observation: 720 + 55 mm prop set $3.99. 8520 + 65 mm prop set $4.49 sale / $8.99 crossed-out regular. Budgets use $8.99, without assuming sale persists. Stock and final price require checkout.

720.observation: Four 7 x 20 mm motors, 1 mm shafts, matched 55 mm CW/CCW props. No loaded thrust curve supplied.

8520.observation: Four 8.5 x 20 mm motors and 65 mm props; 5 g per motor. No loaded thrust/current curve supplied.

range.observation: 102081 breakout listed $5.90 in stock. Supplier banner reserves requoting. Check selected option and 3.3 V logic; listed 0x52 is the 8-bit address, corresponding to 7-bit 0x29.

tof_specs.observation: VL53L0X is a single-direction ranging sensor, not optical flow or an obstacle map. Range depends on conditions.

pins.observation: XIAO pins, camera variants, battery input and board power guidance.

esp_drone.observation: Reference brushed quad hardware and MPU6050. These five carriers are not documented drop-in targets.

kit.observation: ESP-FLY kit $59.99 single / $49.99 at 10+; camera not in basic kit. Not counted as an under-$50 camera drone.

qualification.scope: Five engineering candidates for prepared indoor trials, not five proven autonomous products.
requirements: Quote every BOM line and check under $50 before ordering.
Print and weigh each frame; verify prop, shaft and camera clearance.
Measure selected propulsion at low operating voltage; target at least 2:1 total static thrust-to-weight.
Port ESP-Drone or equivalent stabilizer; verify motor order, arming, control timing and command-loss response.
Implement deterministic positioning/control; LLM chooses missions and inspections, never motor PWM.
Validate camera focus, frame freshness, link failure and recorded recognition on a real 8 GB computer.
Run object-present and object-absent indoor missions; retain misses and false confirmations.
